notes.title: We're live!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44848550/1ac112cfa99e8fb877b732865bd91b4a84d7d925.png[/img]
[b]Hello everyone![/b] I'm Michał, developer of this game. Today I'm happy to announce that steam page is on!
Now You can add the game to your wishlist. I'm gonna add more content to the page later on, but for now it is what it is.
Also I'm going to upload some devlogs with changes I've made in game. So stay tuned!
